description: Test suite for CLI session helper functions and behaviors in the openclaw project, using Vitest framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite titled 'cli-session helpers'.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases with a description.

methods.name: setCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Sets or updates the CLI session binding information for a session entry.

methods.name: getCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Retrieves the CLI session binding information associated with a session entry.

methods.name: resolveCliSessionReuse
methods.description: Determines whether a stored CLI session can be reused based on provided metadata and current context.

methods.name: clearCliSession
methods.description: Removes a specific CLI session binding from a session entry.

methods.name: clearAllCliSessions
methods.description: Clears all CLI session bindings and related identifiers from a session entry.

methods.name: hashCliSessionText
methods.description: Generates a consistent hash for trimmed system prompt text, returning undefined for empty input.
